notes: Eligibility is separate from account ownership and policy judgments.
Only current federal officials, formal current government appointees, and active government institutions qualify.
Private advisers and former officials do not qualify. A historical appointment or a recent source-check date is insufficient.
New or unreviewed profiles stay excluded until a sourced current-role decision exists.
The eligible people retain their dated historical statements; personal opinions do not become institutional positions.
Role changes require a new scope review. Unknown employment dates remain unknown.
